title: Handle an expected error
summary: Ruby: Handle an expected error. Try the text "12".
introduction: rescue handles an error of a named kind. Integer tries to read a whole number from text.
learningObjectives: Handle an expected error with Ruby

blocks.text: Install Ruby 3.1 or later. Save one example as lesson.rb and run ruby lesson.rb in a terminal.

blocks.title: Handle an expected error
blocks.code:
begin
  puts Integer("cat")
rescue ArgumentError
  puts "Use a whole number"
end

blocks.text: Integer cannot read cat as a whole number. rescue catches the ArgumentError.

blocks.title: Watch out
blocks.text: Handle the error you expect instead of hiding every error.
